rubric.item: Spanish copy from product facts only, brand in Latin script, no translated promises or named promotional words
rubric.note: Title, bullets and description cover only bamboo, adhesive no-drill mounting, 2 units, and entryway/bath use for towels, keys and small bags. The brand stays 'Casa Verde', and there is no oferta, gratis, garantía, load or waterproof claim.

rubric.item: Limits from tools respected; metric units
rubric.note: The limits came from get_listing_context: a 75-character title against 200, 4 of 5 bullets each under 255 characters, and a short description against 2000. No units appear, so there is nothing non-metric.

rubric.item: One update_listing call with copy only; answer reports updated.copy, content_version, erp_url and post-write compliance
rubric.note: There was a single copy-only update. The answer reports that only copy was written and attributes were untouched, content_version 3 to 4, the erp_url, and the compliance state after the write (missing_required and warnings now empty, ready still false).

rubric.item: Shows saved Spanish copy with a short Chinese explanation of each claim's source
rubric.note: The saved copy is shown, but sources get one combined Chinese line ('以上全部来自产品的标题、描述、profile 卖点和变体材质'). It does not tie each claim to its source.

rubric.item: No publication claimed; user told where to publish
rubric.note: The answer says publishing has to be done in the ERP and gives the listing erp_url.

summary: All 13 hard checks passed. One rubric item failed: the answer gives one combined Chinese source line for all the copy instead of a source for each claim.
agent_unsure: The agent was unsure whether weight and dimensions describe the product or the package, so it left them out. It also flagged five open points: compliance.ready is still false with no reason given; it wrote only four bullets; search_terms is empty and left unfilled; and it gave the erp_url link instead of opening it.
